explanation: A female kiwi is about the size of a chicken, yet her egg can weigh as much as a fifth of her own weight, crowding her insides before she lays it.

claims.text: A brown kiwi egg typically weighs about 400 g.
A typical chicken egg weighs about 60 g.
A female kiwi is roughly the size of a chicken.
A kiwi egg can weigh as much as a fifth of the female's body weight.
Before laying, a female kiwi's egg takes up much of the space inside her body.

writerNotes: Self-check (guide 9.3), all eleven codes confirmed true. The selfCheck field itself is left out because the CNT-1 item schema refuses it as an unknown key, so the codes are recorded here. lint: content:check reports no errors and no warnings for this item. claims: five listed; high: c1 (number, a comparison label), c2 (number, a comparison label) and c4 (number); standard: c3 and c5. datasets: no pinned dataset in content/datasets/manifest.json covers animal or plant biology (it holds countries, languages, currencies, cities, elements, Nobel Prizes, Olympic Games, World Cups, art collections and Natural Earth), so none applies, and the high-risk claims need web evidence from checker A; one search on kiwi egg weight compared with the female should cover c1, c3 and c4; c2 is everyday knowledge but high under C26. rivalTest: Argued for the chicken: it is the bird people picture laying eggs, and kiwis are small, shy birds, which is why counterintuitive is set. Both values are stated at the precision I can defend ('about'); the gap is more than six times, far past the 1.1 times guard, so any brown kiwi species or chicken breed keeps the answer. volatility: evergreen, a settled fact that cannot change; no time words, and nothing rests on knowledge newer than mid-2026. regional: kiwis are New Zealand birds, but the national bird is known worldwide and the reasoning (bird size against egg size) needs no local knowledge. style: Oxford spelling, plain hyphens only, explanation of 31 words. myths: screened against content/reference/myths.json; no entry matches. mystery and encore: nothing of either kind in a comparison item. doubts: c4 is the claim to watch: sources give the egg as roughly 15 to 20 per cent of the female's weight, so the wording is 'as much as a fifth', not 'a fifth'.

evidence.restatement: A brown kiwi egg usually weighs around 400 to 450 g, so 'about 400 g' fits.
